  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through our service we draw down the imminent Third Temple, which will include the aspects of the first two Temples and the level of "betach badad ein Yaakov," leading to the ultimate fulfillment of G-d's desire for a dwelling in the lower worlds.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is that through our deeds and our service of now we draw down that soon, literally, will be built and revealed</t>
    <t s="1">the Third Temple,</t>
    <t s="2">the aspect of "betach badad ein Yaakov,"</t>
    <t s="3">that in it will also be the inclusion of the First Temple and the Second Temple, and then "Hashem badad yancheinu"</t>
    <t s="4">(to each and every one of the children of Israel)</t>
    <t s="5">even though</t>
    <t s="6">(and through)</t>
    <t s="7">that He finds him in a desert land and in a desolate waste, etc.</t>
    <t s="8">(service in this physical world)</t>
    <t s="9">and He will come from the desert, "badad yancheinu," in the manner that is written before it, "as an eagle stirs up its nest,"</t>
    <t s="10">with mercy and compassion—that soon, literally, the redemption will come with kindness and mercy,</t>
    <t s="11">and then there will be the perfection of the intention that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have for Himself a dwelling in the lower worlds.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Through our service we draw down the imminent Third Temple, which will include the aspects of the first two Temples and the level of "betach badad ein Yaakov," leading to the ultimate fulfillment of G-d's desire for a dwelling in the lower worlds.

translations.translation: And this is that through our deeds and our service of now we draw down that soon, literally, will be built and revealed
the aspect of "betach badad ein Yaakov,"
that in it will also be the inclusion of the First Temple and the Second Temple, and then "Hashem badad yancheinu"
(to each and every one of the children of Israel)
that He finds him in a desert land and in a desolate waste, etc.
and He will come from the desert, "badad yancheinu," in the manner that is written before it, "as an eagle stirs up its nest,"
with mercy and compassion—that soon, literally, the redemption will come with kindness and mercy,
and then there will be the perfection of the intention that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have for Himself a dwelling in the lower worlds.
